messages:
maria: quick ops thread — planning a cautious probe for FlashAttention v2->v3 kernel chooser. Goal: validate latency, KV cache behavior, and batching interactions on real traffic before enabling by default. Tentative canary: tomorrow 09:00 PT. Need telemetry, smoke script, and rollback runbook.

zack: FYI microbench signals: v3 wins for short seq (<512) but we saw regressions on paged-attn paths for seq >= 1024 in staging. Rough numbers: p50 ~same, p99 +12% on decode-heavy routes. Full sample below.

zack: ```
route: /generate-chat
seq=2048 rps=20
baseline(v2): p50=43ms p95=180ms p99=310ms
flashv3: p50=45ms p95=200ms p99=348ms
notes: elevated tail + extra gpu memcpy in paged path
```

jess: flag plan: `feature.attn.use_flash_v3` (boolean) and `attn.v3_kernel_selector` with values [auto, prefer_v2, force_v3]. Recommend: start `auto` + canary `use_flash_v3=true` at 5%. Also expose `attn.v3_sampler` for sampling kernel decisions.

ravi: KV cache note: paged-attn + our eviction heuristic can cause KV churn when prefix fits partially in cache. If kernel picks paged but most prefixes are cached, we get unnecessary page bookkeeping. Suggest heuristic: if avg_prefix_tokens > 1024 AND cache_hit_rate < 0.85 -> prefer_v2. Also add a short-circuit: when model.sampling_rate < 0.2 (decode-dominant) prefer lower-tail kernel.

kevin: profiling shows extra host<->device copies in v3 boxed path for long K/V windows. Flamegraph snippet: `gpu memcpy H2D -> v3_pack -> memcpy D2H` for large chunks. I can reduce copies by reusing kv-buffer pool but need runtime change.

kevin: ```
# quick pprof output (stack counts)
memcpy_h2d  34%
v3_pack     28%
memcpy_d2h  22%
other       16%
```

deploy-bot: Canary scheduled: 2026-03-19T16:00:00Z. Rolling to 50 hosts over 10m. Monitoring: p50_token_latency, p99_token_latency, error_rate, kv_cache_hit, gpu_occupancy. Autorevert triggers: p99 +8% vs control OR error_rate > 0.1% sustained for 2m. Alert ID created: ATTN-FLASHV3-REGRESS.

eva: smoke script I used locally: `./tools/smoke_attn_probe.sh --model gpt-medium --seq 2048 --rps 50 --duration 300`. Observed intermittent 500s on 2/10 hosts. Will attach nvprof traces to the ticket.

maria: Action items (short):
1) zack: add telemetry events for `kernel_choice` + `seq_len_histogram` + `kv_cache_hit_rate` (sample every 1% of requests)
2) jess: create fflags + rollout config (5% -> 20% -> 50%) and a toggle for `attn.v3_kernel_selector`
3) ravi: run KV-eviction sims in staging and add heuristic PR for runtime chooser
4) kevin: produce flamegraphs, experiment with reusing kv buffer pool -> PR with safe fallback path
5) ops: prepare rollback runbook (how to force prefer_v2 across fleet)
Target: check-in in ~2h with first telemetry dashboards.

zack: on it, will push a telemetry patch and add a dashboard panel for kernel breakdown.

jess: will create flags and the canary config in feature-flags repo, will link here. :thumbsup: 

kevin: working on flamegraphs now, will upload to `s3://redwood-attachments/fg/2987654321.zip` when ready.

ravi: I'll simulate low cache-hit via synthetic eviction scenario and post results.

deploy-bot: Note: canary job created (job id: canary-flashv3-2987654321). Automatic rollback playbook linked in the job meta.

maria: small safety additions: collect 1% full request traces (proto) for canary, and enable `attn.v3_sampler=deterministic(1%)` so we can correlate kernel decisions with traces. If anyone needs a longer canary window for specific routes, ping me ASAP.

kevin: one more thought — fallback must be super cheap to switch (fflag flip + no restart). If we need binary change, escalate.

jess: confirm: the chooser will be config-driven; runtime will check fflag first, else internal heuristics. We'll try to keep flips without restarts.

maria: perfect. Keeping this thread as the single source for the probe. If you run into blocking infra changes, call out here and I'll escalate to eng-infra. Thanks.
